New Paltz Town Court

Address: 59 N Putt Corners Rd, New Paltz, NY 12561, United States

Phone: 845-255-0041

New Paltz Town Court is a trial court in the county of Ulster, New York. It is located within the 3rd Judicial District Department. The court handles criminal, civil, traffic and small claims matters. It also takes the thruway speeding ticket received at the highway and the green parking tickets. The court session will be held on every Tuesday and Wednesday. Proper dressing is required in this court.

How to find records?

New Paltz Town Court records are available as a file at the clerk's office. The record search can be found online in the following ways:

  • Searching by name
  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Some information about records is not available online, like serious crime or marriage information, because they are confidential by law and are not available online. These types of information are only available at the court office. You had to submit a form for this information, and then the court would respond whether to provide the record information or not.

How to make payments?

New Paltz Town Court pay ticket can be done in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. Service or deduction charges of 2.99% will be applied if you pay with a credit card.

Online

A person can pay online by using the online payment website PayCourtOnline. The system only accesses by ticket or with a case number. Processing fees will be applied in this online method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address. The address is 59 N Putt Corners Rd, New Paltz, NY 12561, United States. Cash or personal checks are not acceptable in the mail; only certified checks are accepted.

The criminal division handles which types of cases?

New Paltz Town Court criminal division handles cases of crimes that include murder, attacks, theft, and student offence. It is mandatory to appear in court on your case schedule. Otherwise, fines are issued against you. Criminal court hearings are held every Tuesday and Wednesday at 6:00 pm. Hire a professional criminal attorney because, in criminal cases, it is essential to have an attorney.

The Traffic division handles which types of cases?

New Paltz Town Court traffic division handles cases of traffic and vehicle violations. The violation includes speeding, accidents, using cell phones while driving, failing to follow a traffic signal or traffic control device, driving with a suspended or no license, leaving the scene of the accident, not stopping when a school bus is coming, failing to yield and driving recklessly. When you receive a traffic ticket, fill out section A or B for Plea of Guilty or Plea of not guilty at the bottom of the ticket and send it to the court. The court will mail you whether with a court date for your case or with the acceptable amount, and you only have to pay the fine, and the case will be solved . Hire a professional traffic ticket attorney for the case guidance.

How to apply for a marriage license using Zoom?

Due to the coronavirus, the court recommended applying for the marriage license online using the zoom application. You had to mail the court a copy of your birth certificate, photo ids and divorce paper if it happens or the death certificate of your previous spouse; the payment for the certification and all the documents must be in English. The court will mail you the license for the signature, and after the ceremony, you have to send it back to the court, and then an official certificate will be prepared and mailed to you.

How to get a marriage license?

New Paltz Town Court's marriage license is obtained from the clerk's office and is given by the health department of Ulster County. The fee for a marriage license is $40 and for certificates is $10 per copy. The couple's age must be 18+. To get the certification, the couple had to submit a marriage form with a birth certificate, photo ids like a driver's license, Passport, or anything that could prove their identity. All these documents must be in English. If this is anyone's second marriage, a divorce paper or spouse death certificate must be required at the time of registration. If anyone wants the copies, fill out the certificated copy of the marriage license request, and submit it to the court. When the license is issued, a 24 hours waiting period is compulsory, and the expiration of the license is up to 60 days. The wedding ceremony will be performed in the court, but the couple must look for an officiant to perform the ceremony because the court will not suggest anyone.

What is the role of the clerk?

New Paltz Town Court clerk's role is to maintain each case file, help the judges in the case, and receive and handle payment and fines. They are responsible for the maintenance of all Official Town Records and the issuance of various licenses. The clerk's office provides the certification of different claims, permits and many more. They had custody of all records like marriage certificates, birth certificates etc. They are an agent of licensing and custodians of the town records. The town clerk also collects a tax from the town. Due to the coronavirus, the clerk is limiting their duties and is working online.

FAQ:

I am a state driver and received a ticket; what should I bring to the court for reduction?

You must bring your driving abstract when you appear in court; otherwise, no reduction will be given to you.

How can I contact the town clerk?

Visit the court during business hours or contact them using the phone.

Phone: 845-255-0100

When will the hearing of traffic and the civil court hold?

A traffic court hearing will be held every Tuesday and Wednesday from 5:00 pm to 5:30 pm, and civil every Tuesday and Thursday at 5:00 pm.

What are court rules?

The court rules are:

  • No electronic items or recordings are allowed. Cell phones should be switched off during the court session
  • Eating and drinking items are prohibited in the court
  • A proper and comfortable dress is permitted. Sleeveless, tight and torn clothes are not allowed in this court.

What are New Paltz Town Hall opening hours?

New Paltz Town Hall's opening hours are from Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 4:00 pm.
